objective: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to defeat Shy-Rotam.

description: In northern Winterspring, great cats assemble around a large landmark called Frostsaber Rock. The leader of these cats is known by the name Shy-Rotam. Defeating the matriarch of the frostsabers would grant you much respect in the eyes of your fellow <race>.

Go again to the harsh wilds, and once there, gather sacred meat from the frostsabers. Find the stone of Shy-Rotam, and place it there. Placing the meat of her kin before her will summon Shy-Rotam, in anger.
Be ready for her fury, and defeat her.
progress: Shy-Rotam is bold and unforgiving; she will defend her kind with fervent enthusiasm.
completion: You have proven both your strength and your determination. Many more challenges await you, but I have already shown you as much as I am able.
